Fixed the production crash in the report job. The root cause was `topContributor()` in `src/report.js` accessing `sorted[0]` on an empty array when a team (e.g., `infra`) had zero commits, causing `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')`. Added an early return guard for empty commits arrays. Added a regression test in `test/report.test.js` for the empty commits case. Both tests pass.

The report format for normal input is unchanged — only the empty-commits edge case now returns `null` for the top contributor name and `0` for commits, producing output like `infra: 0 commits, top null (0)`.
